featured_reviews.review_text:
The Space is probably among the best work out studios in Mumbai! I say studio and not “gym” because the work outs here are “designed” and not done on machines! And the people here are amazing! the coaches are excellent! I have been training with Coach Rakesh but every single coach there is excellent and they all know exactly what is needed for whom. Physically and mentally! The group classes are also designed almost like boot camps and are so much fun!

The community of people is just wonderful and warm and not competitive at all! It is so subtly instilled by the coaches.. that -  Each has their pace and each has their strengths.. that every single person of The Space understands that!

Cannot recommend The Space enough!
🏋🏻‍♀️❤️

featured_reviews.name: Nikita Joshi
featured_reviews.review_text: ‘The Space Fitness’ is the space for all physical and mental wellbeing you need. Cannot thank the team enough for devoting their time and energy to every individual who joins this place. The programs are designed to focus on overall strength, stamina and endurance and the ‘weight loss’ (which most of the fitness industry focus on) happens as a result and is a plus! 100% recommend this place if you’re looking to get stronger, confident and feel wayyyyy better in life! featured_reviews.name: S K
featured_reviews.review_text:

I made a lot of research and i decided to made a trial class which its 2000 for week. After that my friend and me bought a membership for 1 month to know them better. We loved the instructors (Amit one of them). Very motivating and helping , teaching, very lovely people. They know what they are doing. Yoga instructors also good. It was saying unlimited i thought i can join yoga and another class too but sadly unlimited promise is means only 1 time a day 1 class. So not really unlimited, promise was false. I paid cash we got the buddy discount which was very nice that made us cared by them and felt special. Because when you wanna join a fitness center you want to feel that, caring by from the people who is managing. We really liked it, almost everyday we join the classes. When the renewing  came i contacted with them and explained to them i cant pay online i will pay cash like first time i did. And they are offering %8 discount. I dont know who is dealing with membership department but that person failed to do that their job. They told me they cant accept cash if i don’t pay  online they will not give me a deal. Which they did in the beginning . He/she told me “ if you do 2/3 months membership you can pay cash and you will get %10 off. That’s very not good behaving. I explain them. I dont  wanna do that because when i have longer period of time, some how im ending up not going everyday. Sometimes a full week dont go, because i know i still have many days. Limited time motivates me. He/she said “ sorry we cant help you unless you make longer membership. They end up lost 2 members which  we would be very beneficial for them to have us . We can reach many woman groups. They preferred to not to help just for 1000 thousand rupee maybe less. Owner Gigi is very lovely person but i think  she just doesnt have time to manage the membership plans or supervise them. Because this was the worst membership experience ever. This people dont know what they are doing really. Feels like someone 20 years old trying to recruit the members in a very wrong  way. Thanx for the 5 weeks. I hope for your sake and all that great instructors sake just  in the future will plan  carefully about “ how to keep the members happy and make them come back again”they failed to do that for some  silly reasons .

featured_reviews.name: Helina Vora
featured_reviews.review_text: If there was a 10 star option I would give that! I was never really into fitness but the vibe of this gym is so good it keeps me motivated to wake up every morning and show up for the class. My fitness levels have reached from 0 to 10 thanks to The Space! Everyone here right from the owner - Gigi to all the coaches - Coach Apoorv, Amit and Raki are genuinely helpful and always making great efforts to give personalized attention to everyone whether it is a group class or PT. All the workouts here are unique and they do their best to ensure that they don’t get monotonous and are always fun. My day feels incomplete when I miss the class. The Space is the best thing that has happened to me in my fitness journey :)
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Thank you for your kind review Helina! 
Your progress over this year has been amazing & we are all so so so so proud of you! We are so grateful to have you as a part of people of The Space! Love ya!

featured_reviews.name: Kanupriya Iyer
featured_reviews.review_text: The Space for me, has not only been the best place to start my fitness journey but also a safe haven of calm, good mental health and the best energies. The last year and a half has been a life-changing experience which made me value movement, strength and balance over looking a certain way. A big shout out to my coach Raki (Rakesh) who has made me into stronger, happier person, with special attention to my health history and future goals. I look forward to spending time at Space because of the best people with happy faces and always a kind word to say. Gigi, Apoorv, Amit, Priyanka, Srushti, Ruchi, Abhijeet and everyone else in the world of Space, hope you continue to grow in leaps and bounds because you’ll are the best.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Thanks for your awesome review Kanupriya! It's been incredible watching you progress. Thanks for trusting us & giving us the opportunity to

featured_reviews.name: Avnee Kokatay
featured_reviews.review_text:
Getting a membership at The Space is literally the single best thing I have done for myself in my life!
The studio, the aesthetics, the vibe, the training and the PEOPLE!!! It is by far the most effective combination ever. Not only has it worked wonders for my physical fitness but my mental and emotional wellness as well. Today the coaches at the space and the other members are like family and I don’t feel right until I get my daily fix!
I say this with the most sincerity and honesty, I have never had a better experience (or so much growth) in my entire fitness journey spanning almost 2 decade and I’ve worked out at some of the “top” gyms in the country.
If you have even a shred of doubt, do a trial class come see for yourself and you’ll instantly know what I mean when I say they’re THE BEST! ❤️

featured_reviews.review_text: Spaces Gym provides a fantastic training experience, and Coach Rakesh is exceptional. He helped me improve my mobility and designed a program that pushed me to my limits without risking injury. I thoroughly enjoyed the training and learned a lot along the way. Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.review_text: Joining Space Fitness has been the best fitness decision of my life! featured_reviews.name: Kartik Naik
featured_reviews.review_text:
Sad to write this but don't want anyone to join here with some false expectations set or without knowing the truth.

Got my 5 year old joined in with an expectation to just explore her bits of interest, when we met the Mr. Maurya who told us about the way he trains people without any biased mindset irrespective of their age. Adding to it, we were told that a video would be shared every month to see how your kid's doing over there. We were happy as our kid was excited by the news of just joining the class

Initially, things going on normally, turned out to be coming out with some feedback as your kid being lazy and not paying attention. With time passing by, we get a video shared by the class and Mr.Maurya saying "dekha aapne video, matlab kar rahi hai.. matlab hil rahi.." and so on. Me time and again saying to him, "I am not just looking at the progress from one angle, I just want my kid to explore her interests." Post that, always it was his complaints regarding our kid stating that she doesn't do what's been told to her until the final day comes of this series of events. He shares another video after a month of training, where I don't find my kid in any of the videos. That's when we ask our kid and later him, what happened. Our kid's response, "I was made to sit and watch and the sit was shooting other kids while dancing." And the sir's response, "vo ready nahi thi and saathi me 10 bache aur the ase". This is where I lost it completely! You don't compare kids when they are in training being a TRAINER, you simply train them and rest is for the trainees to pick up. You show them what their mistakes are and still try to teach them from there. If you find there's literally no scope of improvement, you think of a constructive feedback, especially when it is a kid. We do understand that as parents, not all the kids are same but this simply results in something else for the kid and the parents as well.

Very honestly, I completely understand that all the trainees are not the same and there can be challenges as I am a trainer myself in a different forte, but basis biased mindset and not encouraging atmosphere, I believe the kid will have a scar as a broken morale at such a tender age, maybe resulting in not so positive time in the mere future. I strongly advised the parents who come over here to get their kids to learn dancing, please think over it and more importantly think about your children before coming here as they can also be one of them who may go through this.

Adios!

featured_reviews.review_text:
I wish I could say my issues with this place were about the dancing, they're not. It's everything around it.
There's a real pattern here of staff and members being made to feel guilty for having a life outside the studio. Time off requests get met with pressure, not understanding. It starts to feel less like a class and more like an obligation you're not allowed to question.
The part that pushed me to actually write this review, though, is what happens after someone leaves. Instead of just letting people go their own way, there's a habit of rewriting the story afterward, bringing up private details with current students, looping in family members who had nothing to do with the original issue, and generally making sure the departing person looks like the problem.
None of this shows up on the Instagram page. It's all curated smiles and performance clips. But ask around a little before you sign up, because the gap between the public image and the internal culture is bigger than it should be.
Good instruction isn't worth much if the environment around it runs on control and guilt instead of respect.

Dear Owner of Creative Stepz Studio,

I hope this message finds you well. I want to express my gratitude for reaching out and requesting feedback regarding my recent experience at your studio. I appreciate your willingness to listen to the concerns of your visitors and work towards creating a better environment for all.

1. While I understand that mosquitoes are prevalent in our city, I do believe that more effort can be made to fumigate the area in the studio's compound. I don't wish to single out your studio, but addressing this issue could significantly enhance the overall experience for all your visitors.

My 3-year-old child needed to use the restroom, and the only available option seemed to be a common restroom shared with the security personnel. I have no problem with the shared restroom concept, but it's crucial that cleanliness and hygiene are maintained. Unfortunately, the condition of the restroom left much to be desired - there was urine on the seat, a lack of tissues, urine on the floor, an unpleasant odor, and no hand tissues for drying. Ensuring the cleanliness and hygiene of such shared facilities is essential.

3. The most significant issue I encountered was the behavior of the watchman. I understand the need to keep classes on schedule, but the approach taken by the watchman was quite hostile. Turning off the air conditioners and banging on doors to rush people out of the studio can be quite distressing, especially when there are young children present. It's important to remember that children may require a little extra time to gather their things.

In conclusion, I've taken the step of requesting the activity provider to move out of your space because I believe it's not a safe environment for my child, and the basic amenities, like a clean restroom, are not being provided. Given the prime location of your studio, I had higher expectations.

I hope this feedback is taken in the best spirit and that it leads to improvements that benefit all visitors. Thank you for your attention to these concerns, and I hope to see positive changes in the near future.

Ravi and Rashmi will make all those moves look so easy and will keep boosting you until you don't get the move right. And the community you will be a part of is the cherry on top. Its always a pleasure to be there.

featured_reviews.name: Kashish Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
I joined pole dance training for the first time last month, something I had been wanting to do since 2022, and I’m so glad I finally did. Both the coaches, Ravi and Rashmi, are incredibly supportive and genuinely wonderful people. Ravi, especially, motivated me to push through moments when I felt like giving up, and his coaching made a huge difference in my progress.
The studio itself is cosy, comfortable, and has a very welcoming vibe, which made every session enjoyable. One of the highlights of my experience was being part of Beyond Addiction 2, a pole dance showcase event. Performing in front of an audience for the first time was truly surreal and unforgettable.
I’m really grateful to both of them for such an amazing experience. Couldn’t have asked for a better start to my pole dance journey.

featured_reviews.name: komal sharma
featured_reviews.review_text: My pole dance journey has been incredible since I started training at Raashvi Dance under Ravi’s guidance. He’s extremely patient, knowledgeable, and creates a really supportive learning environment. The studio itself is lovely, and I genuinely enjoy every session here. I’d definitely recommend Raashvi Dance to anyone looking to begin their pole journey!

featured_reviews.name: Ramya Seshadri
featured_reviews.review_text:
As someone deeply connected to movement, pole dancing had been something I’d wanted to explore for a long time—both for its beauty and for the incredible strength, body awareness, and coordination it requires. I was so happy to find Rashmi and Ravi.

As a teacher myself, learning environment matters a lot to me. Rashmi and Ravi strike a wonderful balance of being warm, encouraging, and technically sound. Their guidance feels supportive without pressure, and clear without being rigid, which makes learning feel both safe and exciting.

I’m already enjoying the growth I’m experiencing and truly look forward to continuing this journey with them for as long as I can. Highly recommend their classes to anyone wanting to explore pole with strong foundations and thoughtful teaching!

featured_reviews.name: Mahek Shivnani
featured_reviews.review_text:
What started as a one-time workshop quickly became something I truly look forward to. I attended my first-ever pole dance workshop at Raashvidance at the start of 2025 and had such a good time that joining regular classes with them felt like an easy decision.

Ravi and Rashmi are incredibly warm, encouraging, and flexible, and they make every session feel fun, and empowering while still being a great workout and teaching technical skills. They’ve created a space where pole dancing feels joyful and completely destigmatised.

A few months in, I’m so glad I took that first step. Highly recommend Raashvidance! ❤️

featured_reviews.name: Pearlene Sarosh
featured_reviews.review_text: Ravi is challenging, structured, and genuinely empowering. The classes focus on proper technique, strength, flexibility, and control—not just tricks for the sake of it. Ravi explains movements clearly, corrects form patiently, and pushes you to progress without risking injury. You leave every class feeling stronger, more confident, and actually proud of what your body can do. Highly recommend if you want real skill-building, not shortcuts.

featured_reviews.name: Suhani Gupta
featured_reviews.review_text: I'm absolutely loving my pole dance classes at Raashvi! The instructors, Ravi and Rashmi, are amazing - super experienced, supportive, and patient. They make you feel so comfortable, even in a group class, it's like having a personal session 😊. The training is top-notch, and they've become like family away from home. I feel incredibly strong after each class and genuinely look forward to every session. What sets them apart is their continued guidance for staying fit and healthy - it's a complete and empowering experience! Whether you're a beginner or advanced, this is the place to learn, grow, and challenge yourself. Highly recommend! 💪

featured_reviews.name: R S
featured_reviews.review_text:
I started learning Kathak with DanceKatha in October 2024, and it has been one of the best decisions I’ve made for myself.

Learning Indian classical dance was always my dream, and at the age of 45, I finally chose myself and began this journey.

The learning experience has been smooth, enjoyable, and deeply fulfilling. My teacher, Mitika, is amazing ......extremely patient, supportive, and very clear in her teaching. She makes the classes feel comfortable and encouraging, even for beginners that too who dont have any knowledge of classical dances.
And the founder-  Riddhi’s unmatched energy and passion are the heartbeat of DanceKatha.

DanceKatha is a wonderful platform for both adults and children to learn classical dance online from anywhere in the world. I would highly recommend it to anyone who wants to reconnect with Indian classical arts as it’s  never too late to start.

featured_reviews.name: Poonam Panda
featured_reviews.review_text: My 6 year old daughter has been learning Kathak at DanceKatha for the last 18 months and I have witnessed the steep progression my daughter has gone through in this time with her Kathak dancing skills. She has become very poised and confident in her dancing and looks forward to learning more and more from her Riddhi teacher. Riddhi is a fantastic teacher and very structured and disciplined in her approach. The kids are pushed to absolutely do their best and dont take these classes lightly. There is attention on each and every child and focus on getting them better every single time. I highly recommend Dancekatha to everyone kids and grown ups who want to pursue their interest in Kathak. You will be learning from the best !!!

featured_reviews.name: Sushma S
featured_reviews.review_text:
Ridhi and her team is doing excellent job. My daughter who is 7yrs old learning kathak from Dancekatha under the guidance of Guru Olivia. Can't believe the level of understanding and the way she is copping up. Hats off to the teacher patience.. and my daughter learns this class with lot of interest (which is very very important, coz we cannot force them) and will be waiting for it.. For a wonder this is virtual class!
Thanks again

featured_reviews.name: Avantika Prabhu
featured_reviews.review_text: My name is Avantika Prabhu, and I have been learning from DanceKatha since July 2021. These past few years learning under the guidance of Riddhi Mapxencar, and tutors, Shreya Vidyarthi & Olivia Biswas, have been absolutely amazing. Their patience, determination and dedication towards their students is commendable! From the basic mudras to the most intricate ones, they have assured that it is understood by all! DanceKatha has most definitely made me fall in love with Kathak, and a huge congratulations to Riddhi ma’am for the success of Jhankar 2024. The event was terrific and motivated us students to perform on stage for a live audience, making it a memorable experience for us all. So I would definitely and strongly recommend DanceKatha! 🫶🏼

featured_reviews.name: Sretas Passion
featured_reviews.review_text: Dance Katha taught my 5 year old daughter to be more disciplined and the teachings have really helped her enhance her dancing skills to the next level. It has been a pleasure to be associated with Dance Katha and Riddhi Mapxencar Ma'am who polished my daughter's dancing skills at such an early age. Kathak is such a beautiful dance form which has enhanced her postures and focus too. I would definitely suggest Dance Katha to all through my own personal experience. Keep up the good work 👏 entire Dance Katha Team.

featured_reviews.name: Lalita Drolia
featured_reviews.review_text: DanceKatha is passionate about teaching young children kathak the right away. The teachers focus on every detail and aim for perfection while keeping the lessons fun. The dances being taught are beautiful and help the kids connect with their culture. Our little girl has learnt so much in such little time, we are extremely pleased and can see this turning into a long term association. I would recommend this dance school to all kids looking to learn kathak from the comfort of their homes.

featured_reviews.name: tulika pal
